Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery call:

- Goal: 4-week pilot to validate throughput and quality for your user support workflows.
- Success metrics: reduce average response time by 30% and hit embedding recall > 90%.
- Data: you'll provide 6 months of anonymized transcripts and an eval prompt set.
- Infra: you prefer dedicated capacity in us-west with KMS integration.

Next steps:
1) I'll send the pilot SOW and pricing estimate by EOD tomorrow.
2) Please confirm the primary procurement contact and whether counsel needs to review the SOW/terms.
3) If legal needs a call, we can loop in Jonas (solutions/legal liaison) — he's CC

Attachments: discovery-deck-redwood.pdf (deck), pilot-timeline.xlsx (stub).

Thanks — excited to get moving. If priority has shifted for any reason, let me know and we'll adjust timing.
